mapper.select: SELECT * FROM host_tip_intent WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM host_tip_intent WHERE host_member_id = #{hostMemberId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM host_tip_intent WHERE payer_member_id = #{payerMemberId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO host_tip_intent (config_id, payer_member_id, host_member_id, club_id, order_ref_type, order_ref_id, amount, currency, host_share_percent, channel_fee_bearer, payment_channel, status, external_trade_no, settlement_ref, idempotency_key, note, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{configId}, #{payerMemberId}, #{hostMemberId}, #{clubId}, #{orderRefType}, #{orderRefId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{hostSharePercent}, #{channelFeeBearer}, #{paymentChannel}, #{status}, #{externalTradeNo}, #{settlementRef}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE host_tip_intent SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND payer_member_id = #{payerMemberId} AND status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE host_tip_intent SET status = 2, external_trade_no = #{externalTradeNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND #{externalTradeNo} IS NOT NULL AND #{externalTradeNo} <> ''
UPDATE host_tip_intent SET status = 4, settlement_ref = #{settlementRef}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
